qualification.details: Candidates should have passed ITI in the respective trade recognized by an NCVT/SCVT-affiliated institute. Trades under Sr. No. 1–13 require a 2-year regular ITI course; trades under Sr. No. 14–17 require a 1-year regular ITI course. Candidates already registered as an apprentice elsewhere, or who have completed an apprenticeship, are not eligible. Registration on the NAPS portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) is mandatory, and the Registration Number (starting with A0XXXXX) must be indicated in the application form. | Engineering Graduates: 4-year B.E./B.Tech/B.Pharm degree in the respective branch from a recognized university. Diploma: 3-year Diploma in the respective branch approved by the State Board of Technical Education & AICTE (Medical Lab Technician: Government-approved Diploma, minimum 1-year duration). Non-Technical Graduates: 3/4-year degree (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA) in the respective discipline from a recognized university. Candidates must have passed their qualifying degree/diploma in the year 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026, with a valid Passing Certificate as on the date of application. Candidates with status “Appearing” or “Result Awaited” (including pending backlogs/supplementary results) are not eligible. Candidates already registered as an apprentice elsewhere, or who have completed an apprenticeship, are not eligible. Candidates pursuing regular engineering after a diploma cannot apply for a diploma apprenticeship on the basis of their diploma qualification. Registration on the NATS 2.0 portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) is mandatory, and the Student ID/Enrollment Number must be indicated in the application form. | Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Apprenticeship in the same trade can be undertaken only once, as per the Apprenticeship Act. Names on the portal, Aadhaar, and qualifying certificate must match exactly, with no spelling discrepancies.

how_to_apply: ITI candidates: Register on the NAPS portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) with SSC (10th) and ITI education details and obtain a Registration Number (starts with A0XXXXX). Ensure the profile is 100% complete, including mandatory e-KYC and Beneficiary ID.

Engineering Graduate/Diploma/Non-Technical Graduate candidates: Register on the NATS 2.0 portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) with degree/diploma education details and obtain a Student ID/Enrollment ID. Candidates who completed engineering after a diploma must upgrade their profile to Engineering Graduate. Mandatory e-KYC and APAAR ID are required.

After obtaining the Registration Number/Student ID, open the application form via the link or QR code and fill in all details accurately as per documentary proof. The form can be filled only once and cannot be corrected after submission.

Upload original scanned documents (Aadhaar Card, SSC/Degree/Diploma certificate, marksheets, Bank Passbook, etc.) on the portal profile. Mobile screenshots, internet result copies, or photocopies are not accepted.
On successful submission, the message “Thank You! Your Form is Submitted Successfully!” will be displayed.

Candidates already registered as an apprentice elsewhere, or who have completed an apprenticeship, are not eligible. Registration on the NAPS portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) is mandatory, and the Registration Number (starting with A0XXXXX) must be indicated in the application form. Engineering Graduates: 4-year B.E./B.Tech/B.Pharm degree in the respective branch from a recognized university. Diploma: 3-year Diploma in the respective branch approved by the State Board of Technical Education & AICTE (Medical Lab Technician: Government-approved Diploma, minimum 1-year duration). Non-Technical Graduates: 3/4-year degree (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA) in the respective discipline from a recognized university. Candidates must have passed their qualifying degree/diploma in the year 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 , with a valid Passing Certificate as on the date of application. Candidates with status “Appearing” or “Result Awaited” (including pending backlogs/supplementary results) are not eligible. Candidates already registered as an apprentice elsewhere, or who have completed an apprenticeship, are not eligible. Registration on the NATS 2.0 portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) is mandatory, and the Student ID/Enrollment Number must be indicated in the application form. content_sections.heading: HAL Nasik Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is merit-based on qualifying marks — there is no written examination or interview. Shortlisted candidates undergo physical document verification before joining. ITI candidates: Merit score is computed with 70% weightage to SSC (10th) marks and 30% weightage to ITI marks (marks of all semesters considered). Engineering Graduate/Diploma/Non-Technical Graduate candidates: Merit score is based on the passing mark list/certificate of the qualifying degree or diploma. Online registration on NAPS/NATS 2.0 portal and submission of application form. Preparation of merit list based on qualifying marks. Physical document verification of shortlisted candidates (2nd & 3rd week of September 2026). Publication of final shortlisted candidates’ list (4th week of September 2026). Joining for apprenticeship training (1st & 2nd week of October 2026), subject to medical fitness and police verification.

Ensure the profile is 100% complete, including mandatory e-KYC and Beneficiary ID. Engineering Graduate/Diploma/Non-Technical Graduate candidates: Register on the NATS 2.0 portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) with degree/diploma education details and obtain a Student ID/Enrollment ID. Candidates who completed engineering after a diploma must upgrade their profile to Engineering Graduate. Mandatory e-KYC and APAAR ID are required. After obtaining the Registration Number/Student ID, open the application form via the link or QR code and fill in all details accurately as per documentary proof. The form can be filled only once and cannot be corrected after submission. faq.question: Q1. How many total apprentice posts are available at HAL Nasik?
faq.answer: A total of 627 posts are available - 355 ITI trade posts and 272 Engineering Graduate/Diploma/Non-Technical Graduate posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HAL Nasik Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for both notifications is 4 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Which portal should ITI candidates register on?
faq.answer: ITI candidates must register on the NAPS portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and obtain a Registration Number before filling the application form.

faq.question: Q4. Which portal should Engineering Graduate/Diploma/Non-Technical Graduate candidates register on?
faq.answer: They must register on the NATS 2.0 portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) and obtain a Student ID/Enrollment ID.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an age limit for HAL Nasik apprentice posts?
faq.answer: No age limit is specified in either official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for HAL Nasik apprentices?
faq.answer: Stipend ranges from ₹10,560 to ₹12,300 per month depending on the category — ₹11,040/₹10,560 for ITI (fully paid by HAL), and ₹12,300/₹10,900 for Engineering Graduate/Diploma (50% by HAL, 50% by BOAT via DBT).

faq.question: Q7. Is there a written exam or interview for selection?
faq.answer: No. Selection is purely merit-based on qualifying marks, followed by document verification. There is no written test or interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, the engagement process is completely free of cost; candidates need not pay any registration or application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Will I get a permanent job at HAL after completing the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. This is a 1-year apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and HAL has no obligation to offer permanent employment after completion.

faq.question: Q10. When will the apprenticeship training begin?
faq.answer: Joining is tentatively scheduled for the 1st and 2nd week of October 2026, after document verification and publication of the shortlisted candidates’ list.
